title: Packet Length Statistics Calculated on Wire Length Instead of Payload Bytes
description: CICFlowMeter BasicFlow.java calculates packet length statistics (fwdPktStats, bwdPktStats, flowLengthStats, forwardBytes, backwardBytes) using packet.getPayloadBytes(). Pure control packets (SYN, ACK, FIN) carrying no application payload have length = 0. The live flow_extractor used wire_len = len(pkt) (54 to 66 bytes).
evidence: BasicFlow.java lines 137, 151: fwdPktStats.addValue((double)packet.getPayloadBytes()). Sample flows in data/sample_flows.csv show Fwd Packet Length Min = 0 in 34% of flows, whereas wire_len can never be 0.
impact: Artificially shifts standardized feature z-scores from -0.60 to +2.45 for ordinary TCP handshakes. Multiplied across 16 length features, this forces the VAE Mean Squared Reconstruction Error above the 0.330610 threshold, causing 23/27 benign flows to be falsely flagged as anomalous.
proposed_fix: In Stage C, update BidirectionalFlow.to_features_dict() to accumulate PacketRecord.payload_len for packet length statistics and total forwarded/backward bytes.

title: Header Length Features Include Both IP and Transport Layer Headers
description: In CICFlowMeter BasicFlow.java, fHeaderBytes = packet.getHeaderBytes() records only the transport layer header (TCP header length = 20 or 32 bytes; UDP header length = 8 bytes). The live flow_extractor accumulated ip_header_len + transport_header_len (40 or 52 bytes).
evidence: BasicFlow.java:148, 152: min_seg_size_forward = packet.getHeaderBytes(); fHeaderBytes = packet.getHeaderBytes(). data/sample_flows.csv min_seg_size_forward is 20 (49 flows) and 32 (37 flows). Live extractor produced 40 and 52.
impact: Doubles Fwd Header Length, Bwd Header Length, and elevates min_seg_size_forward z-scores from +0.59 to +2.50, directly inflating reconstruction error.
proposed_fix: In Stage C, store transport_header_len in PacketRecord and accumulate it for fwd_header_len, bwd_header_len, and min_seg_size_forward.

title: Down/Up Ratio Computed via Float Division Instead of Java Truncated Integer Division
description: In CICFlowMeter BasicFlow.java line 243, getDownUpRatio() evaluates (double)(this.backward.size() / this.forward.size()) where backward.size() and forward.size() are integers, performing integer division before casting. In Python, float division produces continuous values (e.g., 0.5), causing a slight distributional shift.
impact: Small shift in z-score for flows where backward packets are non-zero but fewer than forward packets (e.g., 1 bwd / 2 fwd = 0.5 in Python vs 0 in Java).
proposed_fix: In Stage C, update Down/Up Ratio to perform integer division: float(int(tot_bwd_pkts / max(tot_fwd_pkts, 1))).

title: Single-Packet Zero-Duration Flows Generate Synthetic Maximum Rates
description: For instantaneous single-packet flows (duration = 0), eff_duration_sec = max(duration_sec, 1e-6) evaluates to 1 microsecond, yielding flow_pkts_s = 1,000,000 packets/sec instead of 0.0.
impact: Elevates flow_pkts_s and flow_bytes_s for single-packet DNS or probe queries that are terminated immediately.
proposed_fix: In Stage C, set flow_pkts_s = 0.0 and flow_bytes_s = 0.0 when duration_sec == 0 and tot_pkts == 1.

title: VAE Architecture and Calibrated Decision Threshold Are 100% Mathematically Sound
description: The threshold 0.330610 saved in vae_checkpoint.pt was verified against the benign validation dataset (N=45,459) at the 99th percentile of MSE reconstruction error. Loading, evaluation mode, and scoring equations are verified identical.
evidence: src/training/train_vae.py lines 66-67, results/master_experiment_results.json line 209, vae_checkpoint.pt threshold key: 0.33060985803604126.
impact: The threshold does not need recalibration or lowering. Threshold alteration would compromise the false-alarm ceiling and invalidate the academic paper.
proposed_fix: Preserve threshold 0.330610 intact. Do not modify.

title: Absence of Raw PCAP Packet Capture Files in Repository
description: The workspace contains pre-extracted flow CSV files from CICIDS2017 but does not contain raw .pcap packet capture files.
evidence: Listing of data/raw contains 8 CSV files (57MB to 105MB) and no .pcap files.
impact: Precludes running raw packet-level replays through Scapy against genuine attack captures without downloading original 50GB UNB PCAPs.
proposed_fix: Document this gap in academic report. Verify live feature extraction against synthetic flows with verified CICFlowMeter ground truth.
